🔎 *CRM dig: 3 weeks of replies re-checked*

*🔥 Bangers (off-market / motivated / under value):*
• *Off-market estate double-wide on a foundation, Collegedale TN*
   Mother-in-law passed, in the estate. Seller thinking ~$225k, agent says worth $310-325k (~70%). Needs ~$30k updating. Address pending
   👤 Darwin White · +14234214111
• *Off-market 3/1 fixer off Hwy 58, Chattanooga*
   Asking $135k as-is, newer roof + HVAC, agent's ARV $209-215k (~64%). Address pending
   👤 Alison Mace · +14236616842
• *780 Autumn Winds Dr, Collierville TN*
   Listed, just dropped to $435k (Zestimate $423k). ~3,900 sqft 5/3. Reno comps nearby sold $530-640k. Agent: 'depends on the number', has had offers in the $300s. Big flip
   👤 Megan Hodges · +19015694733
• *2603 Sunset Pl, Nashville 37212 + 2108 Billingsham Ct, Mt Juliet*
   ESTATE: seller passed, kids selling. Needs flooring + cosmetics, systems newer. Pre-list, 'likely listing at $399k'. Sunset Pl Zestimate $719k
   👤 Sarah Beth Paul · +16153980832
• *100 Morningside Ln, Columbia TN*
   Off-market, rented, fair shape, 3/1 2,168 sqft. Zestimate $307k. Agent says they have a number
   👤 Allison Spader-Keister · +19312158647
• *7801 Impala Dr + 9307 Southwest Dr, Little Rock AR*
   $121k and $117k. 'Both sellers ready to move, motivated to look at cash offers', agent getting their as-is bottom dollar
   👤 Mori Rogers · +15015165693
• *5414 Dudley Rd, Monroe NC*
   Off-market vacant double-wide on ~1 acre, vacant 2 yrs, needs work, owned free and clear, 'ready to sell, willing to make a deal'
   👤 Michael Calabrese · +17042317750
• *519 Farmingdale, Harvest AL*
   Off-market (was listed $200k), 'more wiggle room than that'. Driveway damaged/shifted, DIY LVP needs redoing
   👤 W. Todd Hess · +12565412964
• *9284 Brooks Rd, Olive Branch MS*
   Listed. Seller completely upside down, needs a lot of work, $17k lien the buyer pays
   👤 Silvana Piadade · +19016476661
• *518 Cleermont Dr SE, Huntsville AL*
   Pre-foreclosure + divorce, vacant. Listed $499k, minimum $450k (Zestimate $485k)
   👤 Melanie Brooks · +12566528185
• *5134 Scottsdale Ave, Memphis TN*
   Seller is THDA (state agency). Two cash investors walked as too much work; rejected offers up to $110k
   👤 Myra Sheddan · +19018700154

*👀 Worth an offer (listed or pricier, seller open to offers):*
• *1512 Adams St, Athens TN*: listed, reduced, wiggle room, want to close by Nov 20 (Carol Movre)
• *1685 Turner Rd, Fayette Co + 3740 Ladue St, Memphis TN*: listed, sellers moved out, 'okay with a different price' (Javanha Davis)
• *16211 Lakewood Dr, Sale Creek TN*: lakefront w/ dock, 'bring me an offer, open to all offers' (Emma Hereford)
• *3533 Rhodes Ave, Memphis TN*: listed, owner won't repair, 'seller is open' (Frances Anderson)
• *2400 Rice Planters Rd, Charlotte NC*: listed $350k (~Zestimate), needs heavy work, downsizing, presenting all offers (Kimberly Price)
• *910 Alan St, Manila AR*: listed $174.9k, needs TLC, agent hinted ~$120k (Mark Flowers)
• *511 Rae Dr, Munford TN*: short sale ~$290k, loss of income (Kim Lewis)
• *10284 Eagleton Nest Cv, Collierville TN*: listed $599k, 4,000+ sqft w/ pool, needs updates; neighbor listed $800k (Shay Payne)
• *Franklin TN, 5 acres*: $1M+, house needs work, mostly for the acreage. Address pending (Miki Peek)
• *Gated estate near 161st & Seminole, Noblesville IN*: off-market, ~$1.2M, 5 parcels, horse barns (Stephen Ashpaugh)
• *2816 Hilltop Ter NW, Huntsville AL*: full gut, seller needs ~$130k to walk, Zestimate $146k (Daphne Fletcher)
• *53 Confederate Dr, LaFayette GA*: listed, not moving, owner needs to get out (Benita Clement)
• *7874 Sycamore Dr, Southaven MS*: appraised $270k, contract fell through, will do $245k in 2 weeks (Kenneth Woods)
• *5593 Yale Rd, Bartlett TN*: tired landlords open to investor offers, $225k list (Marissa Hertzog)
• *5083 NC Hwy 56, Franklinton NC*: vacant, investor seller ready to unload, price cut multiple times (Janet Novak)
• *65 Point West Cir, Little Rock AR*: just pulled off MLS, $200k as-is (Zestimate $213k), new roof (Margaret Bell Hughes)
